atoms.exact_source_text: Applicable does not mean optimal.
atoms.normalized_claim: Applicable does not mean optimal.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Supply normally strengthens a valid Turn, softens cost or Exposure, protects an additional subject or stake, extends the action’s reach, or creates a credible alternate approach.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply normally strengthens a valid Turn, softens cost or Exposure, protects an additional subject or stake, extends the action's reach, or creates a credible alternate approach.

atoms.exact_source_text: Core Turn agency is not generally item-gated.
atoms.normalized_claim: Core Turn agency is not generally item-gated.

atoms.exact_source_text: An object intended for one specific lock, creature, Node, or scripted circumstance is not an ordinary Supply.
atoms.normalized_claim: An object intended for one specific lock, creature, Node, or scripted circumstance is not an ordinary Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: It should instead be represented as Node-specific Cargo, an objective object, a Special Artifact, a relationship gift, or a specialized Tool.
atoms.normalized_claim: An object intended for one specific lock, creature, Node, or scripted circumstance should instead be represented as Node-specific Cargo, an objective object, a Special Artifact, a relationship gift, or a specialized Tool.

atoms.exact_source_text: A player who launches with any reasonable combination of three Supplies should repeatedly see credible opportunities to use all three.
atoms.normalized_claim: A player who launches with any reasonable combination of three Supplies should repeatedly see credible opportunities to use all three.

atoms.exact_source_text: The difficulty should be deciding which opportunities deserve them.
atoms.normalized_claim: The difficulty should be deciding which opportunities deserve the three Supplies.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Adopted with complexity correction.**
atoms.normalized_claim: BSA-10B (Supply Synergy in the Turn Interface) is adopted with complexity correction.

atoms.exact_source_text: When a carried Supply is clearly relevant to a Turn, the Turn option displays a small inline Supply indicator.
atoms.normalized_claim: When a carried Supply is clearly relevant to a Turn, the Turn option displays a small inline Supply indicator.

atoms.exact_source_text:
> **PARLEY — Offer help to the wounded raccoon**  
> `Remedy available`
atoms.normalized_claim: An example Turn interface shows a PARLEY option to offer help to the wounded raccoon with a Remedy available indicator.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player may resolve the Turn normally or spend the indicated Supply.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player may resolve the Turn normally or spend the indicated Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: Selecting the indicator reveals the concise contextual effect, which Supply will be consumed, and confirmation.
atoms.normalized_claim: Selecting the indicator reveals the concise contextual effect, which Supply will be consumed, and confirmation.

atoms.exact_source_text: The interface does not introduce a separate inventory phase, compatibility submenu, list of every theoretically plausible Supply, hidden experimentation, or “best choice” signaling.
atoms.normalized_claim: The interface does not introduce a separate inventory phase, compatibility submenu, list of every theoretically plausible Supply, hidden experimentation, or best choice signaling.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supply applicability is visible because remembering an implicit compatibility matrix is not meaningful difficulty.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supply applicability is visible because remembering an implicit compatibility matrix is not meaningful difficulty.

atoms.exact_source_text: The strategic question is whether the present benefit justifies consuming one of the Expedition’s few prepared Supplies.
atoms.normalized_claim: The strategic question is whether the present benefit justifies consuming one of the Expedition's few prepared Supplies.

atoms.exact_source_text: Authors surface only the clearest and most consequential synergies.
atoms.normalized_claim: Authors surface only the clearest and most consequential synergies.

atoms.exact_source_text: Broad fictional applicability does not require every imaginable use to become a player-facing option.
atoms.normalized_claim: Broad fictional applicability does not require every imaginable use to become a player-facing option.

atoms.exact_source_text: The interface shows where a Supply can help.
atoms.normalized_claim: The interface shows where a Supply can help.

atoms.exact_source_text: It does not tell the player whether to spend it.
atoms.normalized_claim: The interface does not tell the player whether to spend a Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Adopted.**
atoms.normalized_claim: BSA-10C (Contextual Supply Effects) is adopted.

atoms.exact_source_text: A relevant Supply provides one contextual effect in the Turn where it is offered.
atoms.normalized_claim: A relevant Supply provides one contextual effect in the Turn where it is offered.

atoms.exact_source_text: > **Spend the Supply here, or preserve it.**
atoms.normalized_claim: An example prompt states: spend the Supply here, or preserve it.

atoms.exact_source_text: The interface does not ask the player to select a second Supply mode.
atoms.normalized_claim: The interface does not ask the player to select a second Supply mode.
